author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
supersedes_status_only: the earlier record is historically correct: Decision B was blocked at that point on the evidence then available. This record may change the current status and does not revise the earlier one

BACKEND_CHOICE.reason: V-HACD upstream is archived and directs users to CoACD; CoACD exposes an explicit reproducibility seed and preprocesses non-manifold input, which matters because eight of eighteen vendor meshes are not closed
BACKEND_CHOICE.claim_boundary: this is a tooling choice. It is not evidence that CoACD passes the geometry gate, which is measured below

ENVIRONMENT.kind: python venv created for this qualification only, outside the repository and outside every other environment on this host
ENVIRONMENT.identified_by: the wheel and native-library hashes below, not by path
ENVIRONMENT.ISOLATION_NOTE: the environment reports only its own packages when PYTHONPATH is cleared. With the host ROS PYTHONPATH inherited it also lists the system ROS distribution, so every invocation clears it, which is the repository's existing clean-environment practice

FROZEN_CONFIGURATION.path_not_recorded: the configuration is identified by its hash. Where it sat on this host is not part of its identity and is not portable evidence
FROZEN_CONFIGURATION.defaults_recorded_as_values: every parameter is passed explicitly, including those that match upstream defaults, so the run reproduces without knowing which CoACD version supplied which default
FROZEN_CONFIGURATION.real_metric_reason: the metre reading of these meshes is derived from the URDF contract and magnitude consistency, not demonstrated from the mesh, which carries no unit metadata. Normalised mode is used and the decision is recorded rather than the unit being assumed

determinism.requirement: five fresh processes, same mesh hash, same package, same parameters, same seed, different output directories, no cache reuse, identical canonical digest

link_ownership.requirement: every convex part belongs to exactly one collision element of exactly one link; no part spans links and no part is shared

completeness.requirement: every collision element in the authoritative URDF has at least one convex part, and no part exists for an element that has none

under_coverage.requirement: no source vertex may lie outside the union of the convex parts by more than the limit. Under-coverage means the simulated robot is smaller than the vendor's model, which is the unsafe direction for navigation
under_coverage.metric: max over source vertices of the distance outside the union
under_coverage.justification: one millimetre is below the manufacturing tolerance of a hobby-grade chassis and far below any clearance the navigation stack reasons about, so a breach of it indicates a derivation error rather than approximation

over_coverage.requirement: generated geometry must not invent obstacle far from the vendor surface
over_coverage.metric: p95 over generated hull vertices of the distance to the nearest source triangle, reported per link
over_coverage.why_no_threshold: a defensible universal limit does not exist: the admissible excess depends on the part's role, and picking one number after seeing eighteen results would be describing them rather than testing them. Reported per link and judged per role instead

preprocessing_fidelity.requirement: where CoACD remeshes a non-closed source, the deviation between source and preprocessed surface is measured and recorded as a derivation
preprocessing_fidelity.metric: max, p95 and RMSE of the two-way surface distance
preprocessing_fidelity.why_no_threshold: same reason; measured and reported, not gated

complexity.requirement: hull count and vertex count per link are recorded so a later runtime cost question has the numbers it needs

sampling.why_exhaustive: a deterministic measurement that cannot be improved by drawing again, and needs no seed of its own

ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT.non_tautological: bounds agreement is excluded. A convex hull inherits the source extreme points, so that comparison cannot fail and is not evidence

determinism.note: raw serialisation order may differ without the geometry differing, so the two are reported separately

coverage.sampling: exhaustive; every source vertex and every hull vertex
coverage.aggregate_caveat: max is reported alongside p95 so a local breach cannot be averaged away

PREPROCESSING_FIDELITY.reason: CoACD's Python interface exposes run_coacd and set_log_level and no separate preprocessing entry point, so the remeshed intermediate for a non-closed source is never returned and cannot be hashed or compared on its own
PREPROCESSING_FIDELITY.what_is_measured_instead: the source-to-collider surface distance, which carries the combined effect of preprocessing and decomposition. For the eight non-closed meshes that combined figure is an upper bound on the preprocessing deviation, not a separation of the two
PREPROCESSING_FIDELITY.consequence: the derivation is recorded as source plus a pinned configuration rather than as two separately auditable stages. Isolating them would need a CoACD build that returns the intermediate

COMPLEXITY.note: recorded, not gated. The contract sets no complexity limit because the admissible cost depends on how the asset is used, which this tranche does not decide

CONCENTRATION.finding: the four wheels carry most of the convex parts in the set. Each is a non-closed mesh whose rollers appear to remesh into many small solids, so the part that contributes least to navigation clearance costs the most to simulate
CONCENTRATION.NOT_A_FAILURE_HERE: no complexity limit was frozen, so this does not fail the contract. It is the obvious question for whoever decides how the asset is loaded, and inventing a limit now to flag it would be choosing a threshold after seeing the result

MECANUM_BOUNDARY.why: a convex decomposition of a wheel is a set of solids. It does not reproduce roller contact, and the source joints are fixed in any case

role_failures_are_not_averaged: a breach on any clearance-critical link fails the set regardless of how the rest score

ACCEPTANCE.no_aggregate_override: a failure on any link fails the set. There is no whole-robot score that can outvote it

isaac_note: Isaac supports convex decomposition as a collision approximation, so the concept carries over. Nothing here was loaded into Isaac and ISAAC_RUNTIME_VALIDATED is not claimed
thresholds_not_weakened: the 1.25 hull inflation limit and the one millimetre under-coverage limit were both frozen before the measurements they judge and neither was revised to obtain a result

OUTPUTS_ARE_TEMPORARY.location_not_recorded: a session directory on one machine is not reproducible evidence, and the geometry it holds is not committed, so the path is classified rather than written down
OUTPUTS_ARE_TEMPORARY.note: decompositions exist outside the repository for measurement only and are not committed or redistributed
